stem: A male neonate has bilateral hydronephrosis, a thick-walled bladder and poor urinary stream. Which diagnosis is most likely?
explanation: Posterior urethral valves occur in boys and can cause lower urinary tract obstruction with bilateral hydronephrosis, a thick-walled bladder and poor urinary stream.
